original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）伊图里省埃博拉疫情蔓延 至少10名学生死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 刚果（金）当局表示，东部伊图里省至少有10名学生死于埃博拉。布尼亚省教育官员公布的数据显示，该省多所学校学生中已确认25例埃博拉病例，其中10名感染者死亡，另有7人正在接受治疗。疫情在学校复课一个多月后仍在持续。

location.raw_text: Ituri Province, in the eastern part of the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Bunia, the provincial capital

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）伊图里省至少10名学生死于埃博拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 10 students have died from Ebola in Ituri Province, in the eastern part of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities said Thursday.

key_facts.fact: 布尼亚教育官员数据显示学生中已确认25例埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Data released by education officials in Bunia, the provincial capital, indicate that the deaths are among the 25 confirmed cases of Ebola identified among students at several schools in the province.

key_facts.fact: 10名感染者死亡，7人正在接受治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ten of the infected students have died, while seven are currently undergoing treatment.

key_facts.fact: 疫情在学校复课一个多月后持续蔓延
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The deaths come more than a month after schools reopened for the new school year, as the outbreak continues.

uncertainties: 该事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
